items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: when Chu Berry come in the band

ctx.x: That's when you went out, probably back to Russell.

That's right. Because at that time, Teddy's band changed completely, when Chu Berry come in the band, and I think Bill Dillard... I don't know if Bill Dillard was there when I was there or not . I worked with Bill so many places. He could have been in Teddy's band when I was working with Blanchard.
Now, you mentioned that Blanchard and Dillard both used to work out at the Y.
